Burn.name: Burn X
Burn.description: At the end of your turn, deal X damage to this minion then divide X by 2 and round up.

Frost.name: Frost X
Frost.description: Attack is divided by 2 and rounded up. At the end of the turn, X diminshes by 1.

Shock.name: Shock X
Shock.description: Deal X damage before next attack then disappears.

Bleed.name: Bleed X
Bleed.description: Take X more damage from any attack.

Divine Shield.name: Divine Shield X
Divine Shield.description: The first time this minion takes damage, ignore it and diminish X by 1.

Regeneration.name: Regeneration
Regeneration.description: At the end of your turn, heal this minion for 1 then diminish X by 1. Health can't exceed its base health.

Valor.name: Valor X
Valor.description: At the start of your turn, gain X Armor & 2X Damage then diminish X by 1.

Vengeance.name: Vengeance X
Vengeance.description: On every attack, gain X Attack

Frailty.name: Frailty X
Frailty.description: Any damage inflicted is reduced by 25% and rounded up. On damage inflicted, X diminishes by 1.

Vulnerability.name: Vulnerability X
Vulnerability.description: Any damage received is augmented by 50% and rounded up. On damage received, X diminishes by 1.

Lifesteal.name: Lifesteal X
Lifesteal.description: On everty attack, heal for damage dealt then diminish X by 1. Health can't exceed its base health.
